_source: Built from the docs, not recorded: the example event in https://docs.bachs.io/guides/webhooks/events/dispute-created.md (every field name and value shape as documented) and https://docs.bachs.io/connect/disputes.md. Changed for TipMe's own account: no top-level `account` (the docs: 'Present only on events from a connected account') and `organization_id` is TipMe's own organization; amounts are a ₦10,000 tip. The docs name no dispute-fee field, so none is here. The sandbox may not raise disputes, so nothing was recorded.
